$comment: The native seed's rules and refusals, in one place, because they were written twice.
tests/harness.js's nativePhone mock answers by these; the Swift that ships holds the same
values, and the tests named in `asserted` compare the two, so neither side can change alone.
A page that passes against the mock must pass on the phone, which holds only while this file
says what the Swift says. Change a value here only with the Swift it names.
The split follows which module owns the value in code, not where the words appear: the Swift
package builds Foxy/Keychain alone, so anything the Bridge owns is asserted on the simulator.
Where the Swift names a symbol the test compares it; where the text is written inline, the
test asserts the literal is still in the file that `where` names.

says.unreadable: the seed could not be read
says.screenOpen: a seed screen is already open

where.rules.batch: Foxy/Bridge/NativeSeedBridge.swift largestSecretsBatch — the most counters one request derives
where.rules.window: Foxy/Keychain/SeedCandidates.swift RestoreWindow.beyond — the saved seed restores to next + 1,000, and a candidate starts at most 1,000 past the furthest range served it
where.rules.candidateCap: Foxy/Keychain/SeedCandidates.swift RestoreWindow.candidateCap — a candidate's counters per keyset
where.rules.candidates: Foxy/Keychain/SeedCandidates.swift SeedCandidates.most — candidates held at once
where.rules.ahead: Foxy/Keychain/CounterRules.swift reach — a counter moves at most this far past next, or to a range restoreSecrets served this session
where.rules.keysets: Foxy/Keychain/CounterRules.swift mostKeysets — keysets in the counter file
where.rules.lockBatch: Foxy/Keychain/P2PK.swift mostReserved — lock keys one p2pkReserve moves the index by
where.rules.lockScan: Foxy/Keychain/P2PK.swift mostScanned — public keys one p2pkPubkeys answers
where.rules.lockCap: Foxy/Keychain/P2PK.swift lastScanned — no lock key is derived past this index
where.rules.largestNext: Foxy/Keychain/CounterRules.swift ceiling(version:) — 2^31 for a 00 keyset (a hardened index), 2^53 for 01
where.rules.showAfterCancelMs: Foxy/Bridge/SeedScreens.swift showPause = RetryPause(span: 10) — no words screen this soon after a cancelled Face ID
where.says.unreadable: Foxy/Keychain/SeedActions.swift — Refusal(message:) when the vault answers .failed (a cancelled Face ID, or a keychain that did not answer)
where.says.ahead: Foxy/Keychain/CounterRules.swift, surfaced by NativeSeedBridge counterAdvance and counterReserveAt
where.says.lockWindow: Foxy/Keychain/SeedActions.swift p2pkKey — an index outside P2PK.keyAllowed
where.says.unchanged: Foxy/Bridge/NativeSeedBridge.swift handleSeedAdopt — a No, or a cancelled Face ID after the yes
where.says.screenOpen: Foxy/Bridge/SeedScreens.swift busyRefusal — one screen queued or open at a time
where.says.again: Foxy/Bridge/SeedScreens.swift pauseRefusal — within the pause after a cancelled read
